title: AI tutor evidence map
description: I mapped the evidence an AI tutor can use across grades 3–9, including patterns that signal a misconception. The map gives reviewers a concrete boundary for what the tutor can infer from student work.

title: Math standards crosswalk
description: I worked through a crosswalk covering 2,194 questions and made the quality of each standards match visible for review.

title: Question bank coverage audit
description: I checked the approved question bank against 148 standards and documented 43 gaps for targeted writing.

title: Grades 1–6 skill tracker
description: I broke six grades of math standards into assessable skills so the team could plan coverage without counting the same skill twice.

title: AI-assisted item design
description: I set rules for question difficulty and answer explanations, then used examples to check whether generated items matched the intended standard.

title: Florida alignment review
description: I reviewed a standards-mapping output against lesson activities and recorded where the match was exact, partial, or needed correction.

title: Texas TEKS correlations
description: I supervised a correlation across two higher-ed math titles and documented where the Texas standards were covered or missing.

title: Teacher resource guides

title: Kindergarten selected-response practice
description: I helped move six missions of standards-aligned questions through a fast draft and revision cycle, with answer rationales for each item.

title: TX STAAR assessment review

title: Geometry benchmark items
description: I wrote standards-tagged geometry items with DOK levels and feedback tied to likely student mistakes.

title: Adaptive statistics questions
description: I wrote adaptive statistics questions with worked answers and explanations that address common errors.

title: Calculus test-bank system
description: I built a parent-item template for consistent variants, then drafted calculus questions with solution and distractor notes.

title: AI assessment evaluation
description: I reviewed generated parent and child items for alignment, clarity, readability, and answer quality, and recorded the issues for revision.

title: Interactive math video
description: I reviewed a video lesson that pairs explanation with questions about data spread so students work through the comparison themselves.

title: Worked examples in math
description: I developed and reviewed short worked-example visuals that show two ways to find the area of a rectangle, from counting squares to multiplying dimensions.

title: Higher-ed statistics worksheets
description: I reviewed higher-ed math practice across a large worksheet program, including questions on confidence intervals and margins of error.

title: Secondary math course practice
description: I reviewed the math and teaching in a secondary teacher-preparation course, including practice on modeling real constraints with inequalities.

title: Comparing decimals lesson
description: I built a model lesson that uses thermometers and number lines to make decimal comparison and rounding concrete.

title: Applied calculus questions
description: I wrote application questions that connect calculus to real situations and show each step of the solution.

title: Student conversation review
description: I reviewed seven selected tutor cases to test which evidence about averages and range could be identified reliably. The resulting notes distinguish a student error from a tutor inference.

title: Grade 1 mission specification
description: I defined how each scored mission connects to one assessable component while keeping prerequisites and grade-level mastery separate.

title: Cross-course learning objective map
description: I directed a map of objectives shared across courses, making repetition and gaps visible before content was revised.

title: Learning objective verifier
description: I helped set up a check that compares chapter-map objectives against both slides and worksheets, then flags where each one appears.

title: Teacher guide delivery case study
role: Case study writing and project leadership
description: I documented how the team kept a teacher-guide project moving through a two-month pause. The successful prototype led to completed guides for two math titles.

title: Time-on-task estimating model
description: I broke teacher-guide work into repeatable parts so the schedule and effort estimate could scale with the scope.

title: Assessment authoring workflow
description: I planned writer assignments, item volume, and review timing for a large calculus assessment program.

title: Math team capabilities deck
description: I presented the team’s range of math work, from assessment writing and standards alignment to video and AI-content review.

title: Canadian localization QA
description: I directed a shared terminology list and QA checkpoints so localized lessons stayed consistent across courses.

title: Water distribution math review
description: I checked a technical training proof against its answer key and recorded six specific corrections to units, wording, and calculations.

title: Five-grade standards alignment prompt
description: I wrote a five-grade check for deciding whether a math question truly fits a target standard. It tests number limits and representations before looking at nearby grades.

title: DOK 4 tutor-task prompt
description: I set rules for an extended-thinking task a student can complete with an AI tutor. The prompt asks for decisions, testing, revision, and reflection while staying inside the grade-level standard.

title: Math question gap-filling prompt
description: I wrote guardrails for generating standards-aligned math questions when a bank has a gap. The questions have to use realistic quantities, clear units, and enough information to stand on their own.

title: Multiple-integrals test-bank blueprint
description: I planned six multiple-integrals lessons by exercise family, DOK level, objective, and graphic need. The blueprint organized 48 exercise sets and 528 questions for writing.

title: Calculus item math and dependency audit
description: I audited a 25-question calculus bank for math, answer logic, LaTeX, and variant dependencies. The review calls out six blocking errors and gives writers exact fixes.

title: Precalculus quiz review log
description: I tracked changes to 17 precalculus quiz questions through QC and SME review. The log shows which feedback on number lines, notation, and solution steps was addressed.

title: Piecewise-function item repair
description: I revised a 27-item piecewise-function set to make graph choices and endpoint inclusion precise. The excerpt shows how the answer options differ at the boundaries.

title: Algebra II and geometry assessment blueprint
description: I helped plan 30-item geometry and algebra forms, balancing item types and mathematical domains so the assessment covers more than routine multiple choice.

title: Residual-plot student activity
role: Editorial direction and math SME review
description: I helped shape a statistics activity that moves from a scatterplot to a regression line and residual plot. Students use the evidence to decide whether a new point is influential.

title: Taylor-series item review
description: I reviewed higher-ed calculus items on binomial and Taylor series, including learning objectives and answer choices. The excerpt shows the section structure and the questions under review.

title: Florida B.E.S.T. to CCSS crosswalk
description: I compared grades 3–5 B.E.S.T. benchmarks with CCSS standards and recorded the strength and limits of each match. The notes make the alignment decision visible.

title: Financial Algebra quality-rubric review
description: I checked a Financial Algebra program against a Texas instructional-materials rubric. The evidence log ties specific course materials to each review criterion.

title: Grade 4 standards remapping audit
description: I reviewed 386 flagged grade 4 rows where the assigned standard changed. The workbook preserves the tested skill, old code, new code, and rationale.

title: Math-content census across technical titles
description: I inventoried pages with math across technical training books so the team could size its review effort. This is the page-level count behind the staffing estimate.

title: Grade 7 circle-graph lesson sample
role: Editorial direction and math SME review
description: I provided editorial and math review on a grade 7 lesson that moves from reading a circle graph to using proportions and sector angles. The excerpt shows the student-facing progression.

title: Introducing multiplication unit design
role: Editorial direction and math SME review
description: I helped guide a multiplication unit from equal groups and arrays through skip counting and word problems. The sequence shows how early concepts build before independent practice.

title: Ratios and percents tutor evidence map
description: I mapped productive and problematic reasoning about ratios and percents using 31 anchor questions and 95 eligible tutor conversations. The evidence sets boundaries for what the tutor can infer.

title: Expected-value student activity
role: Editorial direction and math SME review
description: I reviewed an expected-value activity built around an extended-warranty decision. Students use probabilities and payouts to explain what the expected value means for a consumer.

title: Math alt-text rules
role: Editorial direction and accessibility SME review
description: I helped guide the rules for describing equations, tables, and graphs in math content. The examples show how spoken math can stay precise without overloading the reader.

title: Lesson production and review schedule
description: I scheduled 96 lessons across seven freelancers, from parent-item drafting through review, variants, and final approval. The plan makes each handoff and its volume visible.
